criteria.evidence: Recommends a dedicated read-only role with SELECT only on needed tables/views, column-limiting views, timeouts, and row limits.
Opens by advising against admin credentials: "admin access grants far more than that"; says to avoid admin for real customer data.
Restricts via GRANT SELECT on specific objects, read-only transactions, read replica, predefined queries, and verification that writes and ungranted reads are denied.
criteria.criterion: Restrict the tool to the minimum required authorization.
